### ⚖️ LSV Data Normalization

Standardize raw electrochemical data.

#### 🧪 Logic
1. **Potential Calib ($E_{RHE}$)**: Nernst Equation.
   $ E_{RHE} = E_{meas} + E_{Ag/AgCl}^0 + 0.059 \times pH $
2. **Current Norm ($j$)**: Absolute current to current density ($mA/cm^2$).
   $ j = I \times 1000 / A_{geo} $

> **📝 Variables**: `{...}` placeholders reference global parameters.
